+#!/bin/sh
+
+#########################################
+#     Entry point for X_AIS_UplinkSetup #
+#########################################
+
+UplinkSetupObj="X_AIS_UplinkSetup"
+DualUplinkObj="DualUplink"
+
+prefix_list="$prefix_list $DMROOT.$UplinkSetupObj."
+entry_execute_method_list="$entry_execute_method_list entry_execute_method_root_X_AIS_UplinkSetup"
+
+entry_execute_method_root_X_AIS_UplinkSetup() {
+	case "$1" in ""|"$DMROOT."|"$DMROOT.$UplinkSetupObj."*)
+		# Object
+		common_execute_method_obj "$DMROOT.$UplinkSetupObj." "0"
+
+		# Parameters
+		# .mode
+		common_execute_method_param "$DMROOT.$UplinkSetupObj.mode" \
+			"1" "get_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_Mode" "set_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_Mode" "xsd:string"
+
+		# .CurrentUplinkType
+		common_execute_method_param "$DMROOT.$UplinkSetupObj.CurrentUplinkType" \
+			"0" "get_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_CurrentUplinkType" "" "xsd:string"
+
+		# .UplinkStatus
+		common_execute_method_param "$DMROOT.$UplinkSetupObj.UplinkStatus" \
+			"0" "get_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_UplinkStatus" "" "xsd:string"
+
+		# .AllowAdmin
+		common_execute_method_param "$DMROOT.$UplinkSetupObj.AllowAdmin" \
+			"1" "get_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_AllowAdmin" "set_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_AllowAdmin" "xsd:string"
+
+		# .DualUplink Object
+		common_execute_method_obj "$DMROOT.$UplinkSetupObj.$DualUplinkObj." "0"
+
+		# .DualUplink.mode
+		common_execute_method_param "$DMROOT.$UplinkSetupObj.$DualUplinkObj.mode" \
+			"1" "get_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_Mode" "set_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_Mode" "xsd:string"
+
+		# .DualUplink.mode1 Object
+		common_execute_method_obj "$DMROOT.$UplinkSetupObj.$DualUplinkObj.mode1." "0"
+
+		# .DualUplink.mode1.BackupUplink
+		common_execute_method_param "$DMROOT.$UplinkSetupObj.$DualUplinkObj.mode1.BackupUplink" \
+			"1" "get_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_Mode1_BackupUplink" "set_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_Mode1_BackupUplink" "xsd:string"
+
+		# .DualUplink.mode2 Object
+		common_execute_method_obj "$DMROOT.$UplinkSetupObj.$DualUplinkObj.mode2." "0"
+
+		# .DualUplink.mode2.MainUplink
+		common_execute_method_param "$DMROOT.$UplinkSetupObj.$DualUplinkObj.mode2.MainUplink" \
+			"1" "get_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_Mode2_MainUplink" "set_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_Mode2_MainUplink" "xsd:string"
+
+		# .DualUplink.mode3 Object
+		common_execute_method_obj "$DMROOT.$UplinkSetupObj.$DualUplinkObj.mode3." "0"
+
+		# .DualUplink.mode3.MainUplink
+		common_execute_method_param "$DMROOT.$UplinkSetupObj.$DualUplinkObj.mode3.MainUplink" \
+			"1" "get_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_Mode3_MainUplink" "set_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_Mode3_MainUplink" "xsd:string"
+
+		# .DualUplink.mode3.BackupUplink
+		common_execute_method_param "$DMROOT.$UplinkSetupObj.$DualUplinkObj.mode3.BackupUplink" \
+			"1" "get_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_Mode3_BackupUplink" "set_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_Mode3_BackupUplink" "xsd:string"
+
+		# .DualUplink.BackupOver
+		common_execute_method_param "$DMROOT.$UplinkSetupObj.$DualUplinkObj.BackupOver" \
+			"1" "get_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_BackupOver" "set_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_BackupOver" "xsd:string"
+
+		# .DualUplink.NoWANIPTime
+		common_execute_method_param "$DMROOT.$UplinkSetupObj.$DualUplinkObj.NoWANIPTime" \
+			"1" "get_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_NoWANIPTime" "set_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_NoWANIPTime" "xsd:string"
+
+		# .DualUplink.DelayBeforeSwitchUplink
+		common_execute_method_param "$DMROOT.$UplinkSetupObj.$DualUplinkObj.DelayBeforeSwitchUplink" \
+			"1" "get_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_DelayBeforeSwitchUplink" "set_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_DelayBeforeSwitchUplink" "xsd:string"
+
+		# .DualUplink.IncreaseTime
+		common_execute_method_param "$DMROOT.$UplinkSetupObj.$DualUplinkObj.IncreaseTime" \
+			"1" "get_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_IncreaseTime" "set_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_IncreaseTime" "xsd:string"
+
+		# .DualUplink.DualUplinkFlag
+		common_execute_method_param "$DMROOT.$UplinkSetupObj.$DualUplinkObj.DualUplinkFlag" \
+			"0" "get_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_DualUplinkFlag" "" "xsd:string"
+
+		# .DualUplink.VlanTaggingEnable
+		common_execute_method_param "$DMROOT.$UplinkSetupObj.$DualUplinkObj.VlanTaggingEnable" \
+			"1" "get_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_VlanTaggingEnable" "set_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_VlanTaggingEnable" "xsd:string"
+
+		return 0
+		;;
+	esac
+
+	return $E_INVALID_PARAMETER_NAME
+}
+
+#########################################
+#            Util functions             #
+#########################################
+
+uplink_to_tr069_lower() {
+	case "$1" in
+		eth1) echo "lan1" ;;
+		eth2) echo "lan2" ;;
+		eth3) echo "lan3" ;;
+		eth4) echo "lan4" ;;
+		*)    echo "optic" ;;
+	esac
+}
+
+uplink_to_tr069_upper() {
+	case "$1" in
+		eth1) echo "LAN1" ;;
+		eth2) echo "LAN2" ;;
+		eth3) echo "LAN3" ;;
+		eth4) echo "LAN4" ;;
+		*)    echo "OPTIC" ;;
+	esac
+}
+
+tr069_to_uplink() {
+	case "$1" in
+		lan1) echo "eth1" ;;
+		lan2) echo "eth2" ;;
+		lan3) echo "eth3" ;;
+		lan4) echo "eth4" ;;
+		*)     echo "pon" ;;
+	esac
+}
+
+is_uplink_tr069_eth() {
+	case "$1" in
+		lan1|lan2|lan3|lan4) return 0 ;;
+		*) return 1 ;;
+	esac
+}
+
+get_uplink_cfg() {
+	local idx="$1"
+	local type="$2"
+	local uplink
+
+	uplink="$($UCI_GET dualuplink.@uplink[$idx].$type 2>/dev/null)"
+	uplink_to_tr069_lower "$uplink"
+}
+
+update_timer() {
+	local pid
+	pid="$(pidof dualuplink 2>/dev/null)"
+	[ -n "$pid" ] && kill -USR1 $pid
+}
+
+verify_digit() {
+    case "$1" in
+        ''|*[!0-9]*)
+            return 1
+            ;;
+        *)
+            return 0
+            ;;
+    esac
+}
+
+ubus_dualuplink_set_success() {
+	local result=$(echo "$1" | jsonfilter -e "@.result")
+	if [ "$result" = "SUCCESS" ]; then
+		return 0
+	else
+		return 1
+	fi
+}
+
+#########################################
+#          get/set Parameters           #
+#########################################
+
+get_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_Mode() {
+	local enabled="$($UCI_GET dualuplink.common.enabled 2>/dev/null)"
+
+	if [ "$enabled" = "1" ]; then
+		echo "1" # Dual Uplink
+	else
+		echo "0" # Single Uplink
+	fi
+}
+
+# 0: single uplink, 1: dual uplink
+set_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_Mode() {
+	local new_value="$1"
+	local cur_value="$($UCI_GET dualuplink.common.enabled 2>/dev/null)"
+
+	if [ "$new_value" != "0" ] && [ "$new_value" != "1" ]; then
+		return $E_INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE
+	fi
+
+	if [ "$cur_value" != "$new_value" ]; then
+		local result=$(ubus call hni.dualuplink set "{\"param\": \"enable\", \"value\": \"$new_value\"}" 2>/dev/null)
+		ubus_dualuplink_set_success "$result" || return $E_INTERNAL_ERROR
+	fi
+
+	return 0
+}
+
+get_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_CurrentUplinkType() {
+	local uplink="$($UCI_GET clay.opermode.uplink 2>/dev/null)"
+	uplink_to_tr069_lower "$uplink"
+}
+
+get_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_UplinkStatus() {
+	local uplink="$($UCI_GET clay.opermode.uplink 2>/dev/null)"
+
+	case "$uplink" in
+		eth1|eth2|eth3|eth4)
+			# Ethernet uplink
+			local port status
+			port="$(uplink_to_tr069_upper "$uplink")"
+			status="$(/userfs/bin/blapi_cmd traffic get_lanport_info | grep "^$port=" | cut -d= -f2 | cut -d, -f1)"
+
+			[ "$status" = "UP" ] && echo "up" || echo "down"
+			;;
+		*)
+			# PON uplink
+			local state="$(cat /proc/xpon/ponInfo | grep G_ACTIVATION | cut -d ':' -f 2 | cut -d ' ' -f 2)"
+			case "$state" in
+				0x5|0x4|0x3|0x2)
+					echo "up"
+					;;
+				*)
+					echo "down"
+					;;
+			esac
+			;;
+	esac
+}
+
+get_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_AllowAdmin() {
+	local allow_admin="$($UCI_GET dualuplink.common.allow_admin 2>/dev/null)"
+	[ "$allow_admin" = "1" ] && echo "1" || echo "0"
+}
+
+set_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_AllowAdmin() {
+	local new_value="$1"
+	local cur_value="$($UCI_GET dualuplink.common.allow_admin 2>/dev/null)"
+
+	if [ "$new_value" != "0" ] && [ "$new_value" != "1" ]; then
+		return $E_INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE
+	fi
+
+	if [ "$cur_value" != "$new_value" ]; then
+		$UCI_SET dualuplink.common.allow_admin=$new_value
+		$UCI_COMMIT dualuplink
+	fi
+
+	return 0
+}
+
+get_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_Mode() {
+	local mode="$($UCI_GET dualuplink.common.mode 2>/dev/null)"
+	echo "$mode"
+}
+
+# 0: PON - Ethernet
+# 1: Ethernet - PON
+# 2: Ethernet - Ethernet
+set_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_Mode() {
+	local new_value="$1"
+	local cur_value="$($UCI_GET dualuplink.common.mode 2>/dev/null)"
+
+	if [ "$new_value" != "0" ] && [ "$new_value" != "1" ] && [ "$new_value" != "2" ]; then
+		return $E_INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE
+	fi
+
+	if [ "$cur_value" != "$new_value" ]; then
+		local result=$(ubus call hni.dualuplink set "{\"param\": \"mode\", \"value\": \"$new_value\"}" 2>/dev/null)
+		ubus_dualuplink_set_success "$result" || return $E_INTERNAL_ERROR
+	fi
+
+	return 0
+}
+
+get_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_Mode1_BackupUplink() {
+	get_uplink_cfg 0 backup
+}
+
+set_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_Mode1_BackupUplink() {
+	local new_value="$1"
+	local cur_value="$(get_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_Mode1_BackupUplink)"
+
+	is_uplink_tr069_eth "$new_value" || return $E_INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE
+
+	if [ "$cur_value" != "$new_value" ]; then
+		local uplink=$(tr069_to_uplink "$new_value")
+		local result=$(ubus call hni.dualuplink set "{\"param\": \"backup1\", \"value\": \"$uplink\"}" 2>/dev/null)
+		ubus_dualuplink_set_success "$result" || return $E_INTERNAL_ERROR
+	fi
+
+	return 0
+}
+
+get_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_Mode2_MainUplink() {
+	get_uplink_cfg 1 main
+}
+
+set_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_Mode2_MainUplink() {
+	local new_value="$1"
+	local cur_value="$(get_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_Mode2_MainUplink)"
+
+	is_uplink_tr069_eth "$new_value" || return $E_INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE
+
+	if [ "$cur_value" != "$new_value" ]; then
+		local uplink=$(tr069_to_uplink "$new_value")
+		local result=$(ubus call hni.dualuplink set "{\"param\": \"main2\", \"value\": \"$uplink\"}" 2>/dev/null)
+		ubus_dualuplink_set_success "$result" || return $E_INTERNAL_ERROR
+	fi
+
+	return 0
+}
+
+get_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_Mode3_MainUplink() {
+	get_uplink_cfg 2 main
+}
+
+set_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_Mode3_MainUplink() {
+	local new_main="$1"
+	local cur_main="$(get_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_Mode3_MainUplink)"
+	local cur_backup="$(get_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_Mode3_BackupUplink)"
+
+	is_uplink_tr069_eth "$new_main" || return $E_INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE
+
+	if [ "$new_main" = "$cur_backup" ]; then
+		# Main and backup uplink cannot be the same
+		return $E_INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE
+	fi
+
+	if [ "$cur_main" != "$new_main" ]; then
+		local uplink=$(tr069_to_uplink "$new_main")
+		local result=$(ubus call hni.dualuplink set "{\"param\": \"main3\", \"value\": \"$uplink\"}" 2>/dev/null)
+		ubus_dualuplink_set_success "$result" || return $E_INTERNAL_ERROR
+	fi
+
+	return 0
+}
+
+get_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_Mode3_BackupUplink() {
+	get_uplink_cfg 2 backup
+}
+
+set_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_Mode3_BackupUplink() {
+	local new_backup="$1"
+	local cur_backup="$(get_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_Mode3_BackupUplink)"
+	local cur_main="$(get_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_Mode3_MainUplink)"
+
+	is_uplink_tr069_eth "$new_backup" || return $E_INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE
+
+	if [ "$new_backup" = "$cur_main" ]; then
+		# Main and backup uplink cannot be the same
+		return $E_INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE
+	fi
+
+	if [ "$cur_backup" != "$new_backup" ]; then
+		local uplink=$(tr069_to_uplink "$new_backup")
+		local result=$(ubus call hni.dualuplink set "{\"param\": \"backup3\", \"value\": \"$uplink\"}" 2>/dev/null)
+		ubus_dualuplink_set_success "$result" || return $E_INTERNAL_ERROR
+	fi
+
+	return 0
+}
+
+get_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_BackupOver() {
+	local value="$($UCI_GET dualuplink.timer.backup_over_time 2>/dev/null)"
+	echo "$value"
+}
+
+set_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_BackupOver() {
+	local new_value="$1"
+	local cur_value="$($UCI_GET dualuplink.timer.backup_over_time 2>/dev/null)"
+
+	# Verify new_value is a valid number
+	verify_digit "$new_value" || return $E_INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE
+	[ "$new_value" -gt 0 ] || return $E_INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE
+
+	if [ "$cur_value" != "$new_value" ]; then
+		$UCI_SET dualuplink.timer.backup_over_time="$new_value"
+		$UCI_COMMIT dualuplink
+		update_timer
+	fi
+
+	return 0
+}
+
+get_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_NoWANIPTime() {
+	local value="$($UCI_GET dualuplink.timer.no_wanip_time 2>/dev/null)"
+	echo "$value"
+}
+
+set_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_NoWANIPTime() {
+	local new_value="$1"
+	local cur_value="$($UCI_GET dualuplink.timer.no_wanip_time 2>/dev/null)"
+
+	# Verify new_value is a valid number
+	verify_digit "$new_value" || return $E_INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE
+	[ "$new_value" -gt 0 ] || return $E_INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE
+
+	if [ "$cur_value" != "$new_value" ]; then
+		$UCI_SET dualuplink.timer.no_wanip_time="$new_value"
+		$UCI_COMMIT dualuplink
+		update_timer
+	fi
+
+	return 0
+}
+
+get_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_DelayBeforeSwitchUplink() {
+	local value="$($UCI_GET dualuplink.timer.delay_before_switch 2>/dev/null)"
+	echo "$value"
+}
+
+set_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_DelayBeforeSwitchUplink() {
+	local new_value="$1"
+	local cur_value="$($UCI_GET dualuplink.timer.delay_before_switch 2>/dev/null)"
+
+	# Verify new_value is a valid number
+	verify_digit "$new_value" || return $E_INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE
+	[ "$new_value" -gt 0 ] || return $E_INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE
+
+	if [ "$cur_value" != "$new_value" ]; then
+		$UCI_SET dualuplink.timer.delay_before_switch="$new_value"
+		$UCI_COMMIT dualuplink
+		update_timer
+	fi
+
+	return 0
+}
+
+get_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_IncreaseTime() {
+	local value="$($UCI_GET dualuplink.timer.increase_time 2>/dev/null)"
+	echo "$value"
+}
+
+set_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_IncreaseTime() {
+	local new_value="$1"
+	local cur_value="$($UCI_GET dualuplink.timer.increase_time 2>/dev/null)"
+
+	# Verify new_value is a valid number
+	verify_digit "$new_value" || return $E_INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE
+	[ "$new_value" -gt 0 ] || return $E_INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE
+
+	if [ "$cur_value" != "$new_value" ]; then
+		$UCI_SET dualuplink.timer.increase_time="$new_value"
+		$UCI_COMMIT dualuplink
+		update_timer
+	fi
+
+	return 0
+}
+
+get_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_DualUplinkFlag() {
+	local value="$($UCI_GET dualuplink.common.flag 2>/dev/null)"
+	echo "$value"
+}
+
+get_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_VlanTaggingEnable() {
+	local value="$($UCI_GET dualuplink.common.tagged 2>/dev/null)"
+	[ "$value" = "1" ] && echo "1" || echo "0"
+}
+
+set_X_AIS_UplinkSetup_DualUplink_VlanTaggingEnable() {
+	local new_value="$1"
+	local cur_value="$($UCI_GET dualuplink.common.tagged 2>/dev/null)"
+
+	if [ "$new_value" != "0" ] && [ "$new_value" != "1" ]; then
+		return $E_INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE
+	fi
+
+	if [ "$cur_value" != "$new_value" ]; then
+		local result=$(ubus call hni.dualuplink set "{\"param\": \"vlan\", \"value\": \"$new_value\"}" 2>/dev/null)
+		ubus_dualuplink_set_success "$result" || return $E_INTERNAL_ERROR
+	fi
+
+	return 0
+}

diff --git a/tclinux_phoenix/apps/hni/ubusmon/dualuplink/dualuplink_set.c b/tclinux_phoenix/apps/hni/ubusmon/dualuplink/dualuplink_set.c
new file mode 100644
index 00000000000..0ac1955c800
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tclinux_phoenix/apps/hni/ubusmon/dualuplink/dualuplink_set.c
@@ -0,0 +1,233 @@
+#include "ubus.h"
+#include <uci.h>
+#include <string.h>
+#include "dualuplink_common.h"
+#include "hal_common.h"
+#include "hal_utils.h"
+#include "hal_network.h"
+
+extern struct blob_buf blob;
+const struct blobmsg_policy dualuplink_set_policy[DUALUPLINK_SET_MAX] = {
+    [DUALUPLINK_SET_PARAM] = { .name = "param", .type = BLOBMSG_TYPE_STRING },
+    [DUALUPLINK_SET_VALUE] = { .name = "value", .type = BLOBMSG_TYPE_STRING },
+};
+
+static int handle_dualuplink_set(const char *param, const char *value);
+static int set_enable(const char *value);
+static int set_mode(const char *value);
+static int set_vlan(const char *value);
+static int set_backup1(const char *value);
+static int set_main2(const char *value);
+static int set_main3(const char *value);
+static int set_backup3(const char *value);
+
+static ubus_dualuplink_set_t dualuplink_set_list[] = {
+    {"enable", set_enable},
+    {"mode", set_mode},
+    {"vlan", set_vlan},
+    {"backup1", set_backup1},
+    {"main2", set_main2},
+    {"main3", set_main3},
+    {"backup3", set_backup3},
+    {NULL, NULL}
+};
+
+int dualuplink_set(struct ubus_context *ctx, struct ubus_object *obj,
+                   struct ubus_request_data *req, const char *method,
+                   struct blob_attr *msg)
+{
+    struct blob_attr *tb[DUALUPLINK_SET_MAX];
+    const char *param = NULL;
+    const char *value = NULL;
+    int ret = 0;
+
+    blobmsg_parse(dualuplink_set_policy, DUALUPLINK_SET_MAX, tb, blob_data(msg), blob_len(msg));
+
+    blob_buf_init(&blob, 0);
+    if (!tb[DUALUPLINK_SET_PARAM] || !tb[DUALUPLINK_SET_VALUE]) {
+        blobmsg_add_string(&blob, RESULT, ERROR_PARAM_CODE);
+        goto end_dualuplink_set;
+    }
+
+    param = blobmsg_get_string(tb[DUALUPLINK_SET_PARAM]);
+    value = blobmsg_get_string(tb[DUALUPLINK_SET_VALUE]);
+
+    ret = handle_dualuplink_set(param, value);
+    if (ret == 0)
+        blobmsg_add_string(&blob, RESULT, SUCCESS_CODE);
+    else
+        blobmsg_add_string(&blob, RESULT, FAILURE_CODE);
+
+end_dualuplink_set:
+    ubus_send_reply(ctx, req, blob.head);
+    return 0;
+}
+
+static int handle_dualuplink_set(const char *param, const char *value)
+{
+    int i = 0;
+    if (!param || !value)
+        return -1;
+
+    while (dualuplink_set_list[i].name && dualuplink_set_list[i].set_func) {
+        if (!strcmp(param, dualuplink_set_list[i].name)) {
+            return dualuplink_set_list[i].set_func(value);
+        }
+        i++;
+    }
+    return -1;
+}
+
+static int set_enable(const char *value)
+{
+    HalNetwork_dualuplink_t dualuplink = {0};
+    HalNetwork_opermode_t operMode = {0};
+    bool enable = false;
+    int ret = 0;
+
+    if (!value)
+        return -1;
+
+    enable = HalUtils_atob(value);
+    if (HalNetwork_getDualUplink(&dualuplink) != HAL_SUCCESS) {
+        HAL_APP_ERR(LOG_TAG_GENERAL, "Failed to get current dualuplink config");
+        return -1;
+    }
+
+    if (enable == dualuplink.enabled)
+        return 0;
+
+    if (enable) {
+        dualuplink.enabled = true;
+        if (HalNetwork_setDualUplink(&dualuplink) != HAL_SUCCESS)
+            ret = -1;
+    } else {
+        operMode.mode = OPERMODE_ROUTER;
+        operMode.uplink = dualuplink.uplink[dualuplink.mode].main;
+        operMode.tagged = dualuplink.tagged;
+        operMode.vendorId = dualuplink.vendorId;
+        if (HalNetwork_setSingleUplink(&operMode) != HAL_SUCCESS)
+            ret = -1;
+    }
+
+    return ret;
+}
+
+static int set_mode(const char *value)
+{
+    int mode = -1;
+    HalNetwork_dualuplink_t dualuplink = {0};
+    if (!value)
+        return -1;
+
+    mode = atoi(value);
+    if (mode < 0 || mode >= MAX_DUALUPLINK_MODE)
+        return -1;
+
+    if (HalNetwork_getDualUplink(&dualuplink) != HAL_SUCCESS) {
+        HAL_APP_ERR(LOG_TAG_GENERAL, "Failed to get current dualuplink config");
+        return -1;
+    }
+
+    if (mode == dualuplink.mode)
+        return 0;
+
+    dualuplink.mode = mode;
+    if (HalNetwork_setDualUplink(&dualuplink) != HAL_SUCCESS)
+        return -1;
+
+    return 0;
+}
+
+static int set_vlan(const char *value)
+{
+    bool tagged = false;
+    HalNetwork_dualuplink_t dualuplink = {0};
+
+    if (!value)
+        return -1;
+
+    tagged = HalUtils_atob(value);
+    if (HalNetwork_getDualUplink(&dualuplink) != HAL_SUCCESS) {
+        HAL_APP_ERR(LOG_TAG_GENERAL, "Failed to get current dualuplink config");
+        return -1;
+    }
+
+    if (tagged == dualuplink.tagged)
+        return 0;
+    
+    dualuplink.tagged = tagged;
+    if (HalNetwork_setDualUplink(&dualuplink) != HAL_SUCCESS)
+        return -1;
+    return 0;
+}
+
+static int set_uplink(int mode, bool isMain, const char *value)
+{
+    int newUplink = -1;
+    int *pCurrentUplink = NULL;
+    int i = 0;
+    HalNetwork_dualuplink_t dualuplink = {0};
+
+    if (!value || mode < 0 || mode >= MAX_DUALUPLINK_MODE)
+        return -1;
+
+    for (i = 0; i < MAX_NUM_UPLINK; i++) {
+        if (strcmp(value, UplinkTypeMap[i].cfg_name) == 0) {
+            newUplink = i;
+            break;
+        }
+    }
+
+    if (newUplink < 0) {
+        HAL_APP_ERR(LOG_TAG_GENERAL, "Invalid uplink: %s", value);
+        return -1;
+    }
+
+    if (HalNetwork_getDualUplink(&dualuplink) != HAL_SUCCESS) {
+        HAL_APP_ERR(LOG_TAG_GENERAL, "Failed to get current dualuplink config");
+        return -1;
+    }
+
+    pCurrentUplink = isMain ? &dualuplink.uplink[mode].main
+                            : &dualuplink.uplink[mode].backup;
+
+    if (newUplink == *pCurrentUplink)
+        return 0;
+
+    if (isMain && newUplink == dualuplink.uplink[mode].backup) {
+        HAL_APP_ERR(LOG_TAG_GENERAL, "Uplink %s already in use as backup for mode %d", value, mode);
+        return -1;
+    }
+
+    if (!isMain && newUplink == dualuplink.uplink[mode].main) {
+        HAL_APP_ERR(LOG_TAG_GENERAL, "Uplink %s already in use as main for mode %d", value, mode);
+        return -1;
+    }
+
+    *pCurrentUplink = newUplink;
+    if (HalNetwork_setDualUplink(&dualuplink) != HAL_SUCCESS)
+        return -1;
+
+    return 0;
+}
+
+static int set_backup1(const char *value)
+{
+    return set_uplink(DUALUPLINK_PON_ETH, false, value);
+}
+
+static int set_main2(const char *value)
+{
+    return set_uplink(DUALUPLINK_ETH_PON, true, value);
+}
+
+static int set_main3(const char *value)
+{
+    return set_uplink(DUALUPLINK_ETH_ETH, true, value);
+}
+
+static int set_backup3(const char *value)
+{
+    return set_uplink(DUALUPLINK_ETH_ETH, false, value);
+}

Ifc33996b492d1d64760f6e31f3966bdb8f230d4.analysis:
### detailed feedback
<details>
<summary>Click to expand</summary>

- **Potential Command Injection Risk**: The function `update_xpon_sw_version` uses `snprintf` to build a command string and then executes it using `system(cmd)`. While `buffer` is populated via `omci_lib_uci_get`, if that UCI option is ever user-controlled or contains shell metacharacters, it could lead to command injection. 
- **Redundancy**: Use of `system("uci set ...")` is generally less efficient than using UCI library APIs directly if they are available in the same context.
- **Error Handling**: `system()` calls do not check return values.

</details>

Id720b43fbaca0ff91c89d858f8bb8d6e14238e4.subject: [EUSW-515][APOLLO] Work around DynDNS DDNS TLS stall (WAN egress drop/PMTUD blackhole) by clamping MSS
Id720b43fbaca0ff91c89d858f8bb8d6e14238e4.patch_content:
commit 2cad98a46daf26120f21706557fa2aa179883306
Author: MyeongSooKim <mskim@humax-networks.com>
Date:   Fri Mar 6 12:49:48 2026 +0900

    [EUSW-515][APOLLO] Work around DynDNS DDNS TLS stall (WAN egress drop/PMTUD blackhole) by clamping MSS
    
    - DynDNS(HTTPS/443) updates could stall after the TCP 3-way handshake during TLS ClientHello.
    
    - Under an abnormal server MSS (e.g., 8910) and PMTUD blackhole conditions (no ICMP 'Frag needed'), the large single TLS payload (ClientHello) was observed to not egress from the router WAN interface, i.e., dropped/lost at WAN egress rather than mid-path.
    
    - Clamp MSS on the inadyn socket (TCP_MAXSEG=1460) so ClientHello is segmented under MTU 1500 without relying on PMTUD; confirmed DynDNS update succeeds.
    
    - Changes:
    
    1) Add 004-hmx-forceMss1460.patch: setsockopt(TCP_MAXSEG=1460) before connect() for port 443 and include <netinet/tcp.h>.
    
    2) Update Makefile to apply the new 004 patch during build.
    
    Change-Id: Id720b43fbaca0ff91c89d858f8bb8d6e14238e4e
